description: This file defines interfaces and types related to context propagation in OpenTelemetry, including carriers for key-value pairs and propagator interfaces for injecting and extracting context across process boundaries.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the passed key in MapCarrier.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Stores the key-value pair in MapCarrier or HeaderCarrier.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Lists all keys stored in MapCarrier or HeaderCarrier.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Returns all values associated with the key in HeaderCarrier.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Returns the list of keys set with Inject.

methods.name: compositeTextMapPropagator.Inject
methods.description: Injects context into the carrier using multiple propagators.

methods.name: compositeTextMapPropagator.Extract
methods.description: Extracts context from the carrier using multiple propagators.

methods.name: compositeTextMapPropagator.Fields
methods.description: Returns a deduplicated list of fields from all contained propagators.

methods.name: NewCompositeTextMapPropagator
methods.description: Creates a new composite propagator from multiple propagators.
